title: Muzdalefah (Mash a'rul Haraam)
introduction:
MUZDALEFAH (MASH-A'RUL HARAAM)

In the direction of Arafat upto the limit of Mazmain and upto Wadi-e-Mahshar toward Mina is called Koh-e-Muzdalefah or Mash-arul Haraam. The boundaries of Mash-a'rul Haraam are marked since a few years ago. Halting at Mash-a'rul Haraam between dawn and sunrise on the tenth night of the month of Zilhajj is among the rites of Hajj. We have already discussed the recommendations and supplications of Mash-a'r.
